clips.title: The story
paras: Across the sea, Devouring Plague awaits Forsaken priests who travel far from Lordaeron. Miles Welsh in Thunder Bluff sends the adept to Aelthalyste in the Ruins of Lordaeron, where a signature form of Shadow magic awaits.

In Thunder Bluff, Miles Welsh judges Forsaken priests who have honed their divine and shadowy disciplines. Posted among the tauren, he recognizes when an acolyte has grown strong enough for higher mysteries. Miles directs them back to the Ruins of Lordaeron rather than attempt to impart those teachings himself in Kalimdor.

Beneath the city ruins, Aelthalyste waits in the Undercity's War Quarter. One of the foremost mentors of the Forsaken priesthood, she watches over acolytes who weave shadow. The Devouring Plague drains its victim and carries a corruptive force. Aelthalyste entrusts it only to those able to wield that force without succumbing to it.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ah, a wonderful day for you, friend. I can see by the lessons you've learned that the time has come to send you back to Aelthalyste. There are things only she can teach you, and even then, only if you prove worthy.
I will not spoil the surprise for you, but I remember when I was a young priest learning about true power... Divine power. Yes, those were the days.
Go back to Aelthalyste in the Undercity, friend. She will be awaiting you in the War Quarter.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I would teach you Devouring Plague if you feel you are prepared, friend. A spell of no small power, it will aid you in your coming battles. Practice with it--there will be tests later.
